author: GameTrailers
description:
Blast Blade, the world’s first 3D platformer that’s all about blasting your opponents out of the arena, is fighting its way to Tokyo Game Show with a new trailer and playable build! 

For more information about Blast Blade and to add it your wishlist, visit:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4158670/Blast_Blade/

#blastbladegame #tokyogameshow #TGS #fightinggames 

Presented by Silent Bark Games
title: Blast Blade - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for UnderMire, a stylized hand-drawn first-person action roguelike developed by Table Knight Games. Players will explore a suite of biomes to take on horrific enemies, solve puzzles, and make use of elemental-based weapons along the way. UnderMire is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: UnderMire - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Announcement Trailer for Velkor, a third-person open-world survival game developed by Zazuna Team. Players will explore the dangers of what remains in a world that's been brought to it's knees. Establish camps, make use of a variety of weapons, and reveal the truth under it all. Velkor is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Velkor - Official Gameplay Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Puzzlez: A Shapez Game announcement trailer for this upcoming standalone puzzle game based on the shapez series. In Puzzlez: A Shapez Game, players construct shapes inside of handcrafted 3D dioramas to solve optimization-based puzzleboxes that progress from simple production chains to multi-floor logistical problems involving shapes and fluids. Players can also use an in-built puzzle editor to craft and share their own puzzles with the community. Puzzlez: A Shapez Game will be available on Steam in 2027.
title: Puzzlez: A Shapez Game - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Battle for Tokyo Trailer for Minecraft Dungeons 2, an action-adventure RPG installment in the Minecraft universe developed by Double Eleven and Mojang Studios. Players will embark on a grand adventure through uncharted lands to take on hordes of enemies and stop a new evil from taking hold. Minecraft Dungeons 2 is launching on September 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox Cloud, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 - Official Battle for Tokyo Trailer (English Subtitles)

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet two new survivors coming to Risk of Rain 2 in this latest trailer for the roguelike action game. The Acolyte is a close-range glaive-wielding Survivor who can wield powerful combos, but not without cost. The Enforcer is a defensive vanguard and a Survivor who combines powerful defense with dynamic, tactical movement. The Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts expansion will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Risk of Rain 2 - Official Acolyte and Enforcer Survivors Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Riders of the Underground' Update Release Date Trailer for Core Keeper, a pixel-based survival exploration game developed by Pugstorm. Players can soon enjoy a new update with the Riders of the Underground, packed with rideable mounts, a new moss sub-biome, new pets, and more. The 'Riders of the Underground' Update for Core Keeper is launching on September 21 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Core Keeper - Official 'Riders of the Underground' Update Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Dungeon Automata, a fantasy dungeon crawler auto battler developed by Medium-Rare Games. Players will analyze enemy actions, customize their party, and take on brutal dungeons through trial and error. Dungeon Automata is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Dungeon Automata - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Skull and Bones trailer for a peek at gameplay from the Abyssal Envoy time-limited world event coming to the open-world action naval RPG. During this time-limited world event, face the Abyssal Envoy in a new showdown and earn new rewards. The Abyssal Envoy event for Skull and Bones begins on September 15, 2026.
title: Skull and Bones - Official Abyssal Envoy Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Join senior game designer Taymoor Rehman at Firaxis for a deep dive into Civilization 7's September update 1.5.0, including the True Start Location (TSL) Earth map, updated map generation, the new Hall of History Collection, and more fixes and improvements for the strategy sim game. Civilization 7 is available now on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). Update 1.5.0 launches on September 15, 2026.
title: Civilization 7 - Official Developer Update: September 2026 Video

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Overview and Quick Start Guide for Steam Frame, the latest VR Headset developed by Valve. Get the rundown on the box contents, the startup process, and how to get the Steam Frame up and running. Steam Frame reservations are live now, with official purchase emails being sent on September 17.
title: Steam Frame - Official Overview and Quick Start Guide

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Game Overview Trailer for Blackwood, a third-person action-adventure game developed by AttritoM7 Productions. Players will run a DVD store by day and embody a ruthless assassin by night, with intense melee combat and tight gunplay. Get the rundown on the game's offerings with Blackwood, launching on September 16 for PC (Steam).
title: Blackwood - Official Game Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Version 1.0 of TCG Card Shop Simulator will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 on September 15, 2026. Check out the TCG Card Shop Simulator version 1.0 launch trailer to see gameplay features and the playable Tetramon TCG, where you can battle other players with the cards you collect.
title: TCG Card Shop Simulator - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Time to Wake Up gets a new trailer and a release date. Watch the latest Time to Wake Up trailer for this psychological thriller game. The new trailer takes you into its surreal world. Time to Wake Up will be available on Steam and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on October 12, 2026. It is also coming to Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch soon after.

Descend into Alan Malone’s mind. Wander through hallways made up of dozens of bedrooms with cobwebs of quotes and never-ending classrooms. Search for a mysterious book in a locker-based maze and avoid those creepy-looking students with their incessant stares.
title: Time To Wake Up - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for Stones Keeper: Director's Cut, an improved update to the dark fantasy turn-based strategy game developed by SK Team. Players will lead the Order of the Griffin into battle to complete story quests, seek out ancient ruins, and assume control of a flying island. The Director's Cut is packed with new features, including a reimagined campaign, enhanced visuals, new gameplay features, and more. Stones Keeper: Director's Cut is available now for PC (Steam and GoG).
title: Stones Keeper: Director's Cut - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the 'Creatures of Greece' Overview Trailer for Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, an upcoming remake of the original Tomb Raider action-adventure game developed by Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog. Players can get a behind-the-scenes look at what Lara Croft will face in Greece, from crocodiles to leapords. Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is launching on February 12 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis - Official 'Creatures of Greece' Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Teaser Trailer for Glow Tail, a multiplayer asymmetrical horror party game developed by KaashFusion Studio. Players will either seek out pesky mice with glowing tails or embody the Hunter tasked with seeking them out. Glow Tail is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Glow Tail - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Somnius, a first-person co-op extraction shooter developed by STFGames. Players will do what's necessary to save the Dreamer before all hope is lost. Wield a powerful vacuum gun, manage inventory, and protect the world from certain doom. Somnius is launching on September 22 for PC (Steam).
title: Somnius - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for LightSup!, a co-op dungeon adventure game developed by Bugblio Studio. Players will take on powerful monsters in the ultimate fight to keep the world away from the devastation of darkness. Embark on quests, make use of new weapons, and save the Lumineia Kingdom. LightSup! is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: LightSup! - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join game director Derek Paxton at developer Amplitude Studios for a deep dive into the Sandshapers faction in this latest Endless Legend 2 trailer for the upcoming 4X strategy game. Learn about the Sandshapers units, their ability, what affects them, and more. Endless Legend 2 is currently in Early Access, and version 1.0 will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, Xbox on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on September 17, 2026.

Lead your people to victory on an ever-evolving world in this strategy game featuring asymmetric factions led by powerful heroes. Build your empire, wield political influence, and raise grand armies to wage war in a race to uncover dark secrets buried within the planet in Endless Legend 2.
title: Endless Legend 2 - Official Shadshapers Faction Spotlight Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Learn about the Institute and the story of The Lift in this new trailer for the upcoming supernatural handyman simulator game. In The Lift, you are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2027.
title: The Lift - Official Story Trailer | TinyBuild Connect Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a new look at gameplay from Trainfort in this latest trailer for the upcoming open-world co-op survival crafting game. As a dwarf nomad, hit the road of this post-apocalyptic world with your bearded mates. Build a moving steam engine, pack your base with you, and explore the wilderness. The country is big, your legs are short, but you gotta keep moving! Trainfort will be available on PC. You can now sign up for the upcoming Steam Playtest if you're interested.
title: Trainfort - Official Playtest Trailer | TinyBuild Connect Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Samurais. Ninjas. Snow monkeys. Hot springs. You are Taomaru, a capybara monk who treats every battle like a minor inconvenience. As you casually stroll through a dangerous mission, outsmart and defeat your enemies with the ancient art of Yuzutsu. Check out the Yuzutsu announcement trailer for this upcoming 2.5D puzzle-action game where fighting doesn't require brute force. The Yuzutsu trailer showcases gameplay and more of what to expect. 

Yuzutsu will be available on PC in Q3 2027.
title: Yuzutsu - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion Release Date Trailer for Tempest Rising, a real-time strategy game developed by Slipgate Ironworks. Players can get a new look at the upcoming expansion that brings 11 new missions from the perspective of the Veti, a powerful and technologically advanced faction established in previous instances in the game. Take on ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion in Tempest Rising on September 29 for PC (Steam).
title: Tempest Rising - Official ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Anniversary Update Trailer for Jump Space, a sci-fi first-person action co-op game developed by Keepsake Games. Players can gain access to a suite of new features with the latest update, including a new inventory system, auto-save, a challenge rating implementation, and more rewards to celebrate the game's anniversary. The Anniversary Update for Jump Space is available now for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam).
title: Jump Space - Official Anniversary Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a closer look at the Switch Axe Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. With the Switch Axe Boosted Action, you can blast and build Switch and Amp gauge, you can burst forward with element discharge, and unleash new combos and follow-ups. 

Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await. 

Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance - Official Switch Axe Boosted Action Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Yu Shinjo Character Trailer for Stranger Than Heaven, an upcoming action game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio. Players will become acquainted with Yu Shinjo, a man of action who's made the necessay choices to rise to riches and prominence in the world of Stranger Than Heaven. Stranger Than Heaven is launching on January 15 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam).
title: Stranger Than Heaven - Official Yu Shinjo Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Adagio Trailer for Gears of War: E-Day, the upcoming prequel to the hit third-person action shooter developed by The Coalition. Players will find themselves in the heart of Emergence Day as the Locust Horde rises from the depths and sets humanity on a collision course. Gears of War: E-Day is launching on October 6 for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam).
title: Gears of War: E-Day - Official Adagio Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Truck-kun is Supporting Me From Another World?! is available now on Nintendo Switch 2. An update is also out now on PC, with the update coming to Switch 2 and Xbox. Watch the Truck-kun is Supporting Me From Another World?! Nintendo Switch 2 launch trailer to see its fantasy world and gameplay. Truck-kun is Supporting Me From Another World?! is a humorous, OVA-sized spin on the “truck-kun” isekai meme, inspired by the long-running anime and manga trope of protagonists being transported to fantasy worlds after being hit by a delivery truck.
title: Truck-kun is Supporting Me from Another World?! - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Playtest Launch Trailer for Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs, a pixel-based narrative choice game developed by Terletski Games. Players will interact with a totalitarian dog state with multiple endings, puzzles, and a sprawling narrative filled with sinister secrets. Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now.
title: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs - Official Playtest Launch Trailer
